summary:
**SPACEKEEPERS: Every Machine Has a Mission. Every Mission Has a Story.**

SPACEKEEPERS is an interactive educational website designed to introduce school-age students to the remarkable spacecraft and scientific equipment NASA has sent across our solar system. Through engaging mission profiles, visual storytelling, timelines, and interactive quizzes, students can explore machines such as Voyager 1, Hubble Space Telescope, Cassini, Opportunity, and InSight.

The project addresses NASA’s challenge by transforming complex space mission data into accessible, engaging stories that explain each machine’s purpose, achievements, discoveries, and current status. It helps students understand not only what these machines explored, but also how their scientific contributions continue to shape our knowledge of the universe.

SPACEKEEPERS is important because it makes space science more approachable for young learners, encourages curiosity and scientific thinking, and highlights the lasting value of exploration—even after a mission ends.
details:
SPACEKEEPERS is an interactive educational website designed to make space exploration exciting and accessible for school-age students. It transforms NASA's space missions into engaging stories, allowing young explorers to discover the machines sent across our solar system, understand their purposes, explore their scientific achievements, and learn about their current mission status.

The website features spacecraft profiles, mission information, visual storytelling, timelines, and interactive quizzes. Students can explore missions such as Voyager 1, Hubble, Cassini, Opportunity, and InSight while learning how each mission contributed to our understanding of space.

The main benefit of SPACEKEEPERS is that it turns complex scientific information into simple, engaging educational content. Its intended impact is to encourage curiosity, develop scientific thinking, and inspire the next generation of space enthusiasts.

The project was developed as a web-based experience using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with AI-assisted development tools such as Google Antigravity. NASA information and resources were used to support the educational content.

What makes SPACEKEEPERS creative is its storytelling approach: instead of presenting spacecraft as machines with technical specifications, it presents each one as a story of exploration and discovery. We considered the target audience's age, ease of navigation, visual engagement, accessibility, responsive design, and the importance of presenting scientific information accurately.

Our central idea is simple: A mission may end, but its discoveries live on.
